title: What If Everyone on Earth Jumped at Once?

scenes.text: What if every person on Earth jumped at the same moment? You'd expect an earthquake.
First, you'd need room. Everyone could stand in an area about the size of Los Angeles.
Then, everyone jumps. Together, we are tiny next to the planet.
Earth would move by less than the width of a hydrogen atom.
And when we land, it settles back to where it started.
No one would notice a thing. Idling a car with the AC on does more damage to Earth.

description:
What if everyone on Earth jumped at once?
The whole planet would shift by less than the width of an atom.
What should we run through next?
first_comment: What's the biggest thing you'd want everyone to do at once? Drop your own 'what if' below.
